description: The CI check scripts/check_module_budget_label_actor.py requires the module-budget-change label on a change to holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json to come from a repository administrator, but it never reads the flow intent of the pull request. A pull request that changes the budget file and carries the admin-applied label, but whose intent has no module_budget_change field, therefore passes. The invariant is that the budget file changes only with both the label and the intent field.
goal: Extend scripts/check_module_budget_label_actor.py so that, when holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json changes between --base and --head, it also requires the pull request's flow intent to carry a non-empty module_budget_change field: read the intent rows added by the pull request in holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/intents/*.jsonl and holon-knowledge/ledger/intents.jsonl (git diff added lines between base and head), fail with a message naming the missing or empty field when no added intent row has a non-empty string module_budget_change, and keep the existing label-actor refusals and the unchanged-file pass. Wire the check into the existing hygiene workflow step only if the step needs a new argument or checkout depth; do not add a new workflow. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Both halves of the maintainer authorisation (admin-applied label, intent field quoting the instruction) must be checked in CI, or an agent can change a module budget with the label alone.
acceptance_criteria: CI also requires the flow intent of the PR to carry a non-empty module_budget_change when holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json changes.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_module_budget_label_actor.py with a real temporary git repository whose head commit changes holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and adds an intent row without a module_budget_change field, with the module-budget-change label applied by an admin user (fake opener), asserts scripts/check_module_budget_label_actor.py exits non-zero and the stderr names module_budget_change.
The same test file asserts an added intent row whose module_budget_change is an empty or whitespace-only string also fails.

The same test file asserts the same change passes (exit 0) when an added intent row carries a non-empty module_budget_change and the label was applied by an admin, and that a pull request that does not change holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json passes without any intent row.
The existing label-actor refusals (label never applied, removed, applied by a non-admin or by a bot) still fail as before.
The check runs automatically in CI through the hygiene workflow .github/workflows/test-hygiene.yml; no agent has to remember it.
Target CI: a PR changing the budget file fails unless it carries the `module-budget-change` label applied by the maintainer account (check the label event actor), and the intent has the field.
The check runs automatically (pre-commit hook and/or CI, and the flow gate where it applies); no agent has to remember it.
The check is proven to fail on a real or reconstructed violation (a test with today's evidence) before it is trusted, and passes on the cleaned state.
Self-explaining code invariant in anything written: no docstrings, no comments except `# why:`.
Target-repository work goes through `holon flow`; the intent never names harness paths or bean ids.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
